name: coin-flip
summary: Count how many times a tossed coin flips, after the take, from 240 fps iPhone frames.

hardware.camera: an iPhone that records 240 fps, running the GAMST 240 app (apps/ios-highspeed-camera, iOS 15+), on a stand, on the Mac's Wi-Fi
hardware.compute: Apple silicon with MPS; one toss counts in about 30 s on an M2 Pro

measured: 6 of 7 tosses within one flip of a person's frame-by-frame count (docs/halo-coin.md)
